Sanborn Fire Insurance Map, Laurel Springs, Camden County, New Jersey, December 1922, Sheet 8

properties.name: Chews Landing Road / West Park Avenue

sheet-7.description: Sheet 7 of the Laurel Springs series, dated December 1922 and drawn at 100 feet to the inch, covers the western half of the Laurel Springs Manor development, a regular grid of long narrow building lots south of the lake shore. The sheet is bounded on the west by Laurel Avenue, on the north by Lake Boulevard and the curving shore lanes, on the east by the column of blocks east of Central Avenue, and on the south by Chews Landing Road, below which the north edges of blocks 173 to 175 are shown. Between Laurel, Homesite and Central Avenues the numbered avenues from Third to Tenth run across the sheet, dividing it into blocks 125 to 170, each platted into lots of about 25 feet frontage. Development is sparse: most blocks are empty lots, with scattered one and two storey frame dwellings, small outbuildings and chicken coops, mostly near Laurel Avenue and along the avenues west of Central Avenue. Along the shore at the top, Neptune Walk, Mermaid Walk, Terrace Landing and Manor Landing run north from Lake Boulevard toward the water, which lies off the sheet; Woodland and Clover Avenues reach only from Lake Boulevard to Fourth Avenue. A fire bell stands at the corner of Seventh and Central Avenues. A short row of dwellings and a store line the south side of Chews Landing Road at Laurel Avenue. The sheet shares its eastern column of blocks (129 to 170) with sheet 8, which continues the grid east to Scott Avenue and beyond. The north arrow points to the upper left, so the avenues run roughly northwest to southeast on the ground.
notes: Laurel Av is modern Laurel Road; the numbered avenues are modern 3rd to 10th Avenue.
Clover Av, Neptune Walk and Mermaid Walk have no modern street of that name in OpenStreetMap.
Copyright line reads 1921; title cartouche reads Dec. 1922.

Laurel Springs Manor (Laurel Springs series sheet 7), 100 ft. Laurel Av (now Laurel Road), Woodland, Clover, Homesite and Central Avs; Lake Boulevard, Second to Tenth Avs, Chews Landing Road. One part; right margin torn (mask stops at x 8440). Overlaps sheet 8 by one column of blocks (129 to 170).

sheet-8.description: Sheet 8 of the Laurel Springs series, dated December 1922 and drawn at 100 feet to the inch, covers the eastern half of the Laurel Springs Manor development. Its western column of blocks (129 to 170) repeats the eastern column of sheet 7. West of Scott Avenue the regular grid continues: Cottage Avenue and the short Elm Avenue cross the numbered avenues from Second to Tenth, with blocks 129 to 171 platted in narrow lots, and a cluster of buildings and a triangular lot where Elm Avenue meets Sixth Avenue. Scott Avenue is the main north-south street; its east side is lined with narrow lots and carries most of the buildings on the sheet, including a fire hall and a gong alarm near Fourth Avenue and a fire bell near Ninth Avenue. East of Scott Avenue the land is drawn on a different, angled grid: Columbia Avenue, Wade Avenue and Second to Sixth Avenues form blocks 132 to 149 between Columbia Avenue and Park Avenue, which runs diagonally from the upper right to Chews Landing Road. Block 131, between Scott and Columbia Avenues, holds a club and a few dwellings. Wright Avenue and Miller Avenue bound the large, mostly empty block 155, and blocks 172, 178, 179 and 180 east of Wright and Park Avenues are open land. Chews Landing Road runs along the bottom; south of it at Scott Avenue are a dwelling, coops and a corn crib in block 177. Most lots in the development are still vacant, with scattered one and two storey frame dwellings, sheds and chicken coops. The north arrow points to the upper left.
notes: Park Av is modern West Park Avenue; the numbered avenues are modern 2nd to 10th Avenue.
At Scott Avenue the old Second Av meets Scott where OpenStreetMap has Scott Avenue / Wade Avenue.
Columbia Av south of Wade Av is not in OpenStreetMap today.
Chews Landing Road / Cottage Avenue (now also Georgetown Road) lies about 10 m from the drawn junction and was rejected.

Laurel Springs Manor (sheet 8), 100 ft. Cottage, Elm, Scott, Wright, Columbia, Park (now West Park Avenue) Avs; Wade, Miller; Second to Tenth Avs; Chews Landing Road. East of Scott the blocks are drawn on their own angled grid (Second to Sixth Av meeting Park Av), still one part. Old Second Av east of Scott is modern Wade Avenue.
